name: intel-endpoint-smoke-test-report
description: Send one OpenAI-compatible chat request to a local OpenVINO Model Server (OVMS) on Windows and report whether the endpoint answered. Use after OVMS is running, usually after intel-ovms-agentic-setup and, when the agent should use that server, intel-agent-provider-config. The default endpoint is localhost port 8000. A passing smoke test shows the server responded. It does not install the Intel AI PC Developer Kit, start OVMS, or switch Hermes or OpenClaw onto that server. Not for VS Code Continue setup (openvino-coding-assistant on port 8000).
